entries.title: HCC lesion-level 99mTc-MAA TBR and heterogeneity
entries.notes: 59 HCC patients and 77 lesions; within-patient correlation is not reported.

entries.title: Adult liver volume associations with body size
entries.notes: The equation 14*weight+979 is an upper limit of normal, not a generative mean.

entries.title: Normal liver segment volumes and left-liver fraction
entries.notes: Used for a truncated normal-liver fraction target, not exact Couinaud reconstruction.

entries.title: Segmental liver volume ratio changes with cirrhosis
entries.notes: Directional proxy targets only.

entries.title: Population MRI liver diameters and segmented volume (SHIP healthy subgroup n=886)
entries.notes: Healthy mean SI/AP/LR 172/158/197 mm with SD 20/19/23 mm; healthy segmented volume 1469.3 +/- 292.9 mL. Single diameters correlated poorly with volume, so axes and volume must be treated jointly.

entries.title: Population-scale 3D MRI liver shape analysis (UK Biobank n=33,434)
entries.notes: Regional surface shape varies with age, BMI, waist-to-hip ratio, liver fat, iron and disease; this rejects a single frozen outer contour as a population model.

entries.title: MDCT segment volumetry in cirrhosis by aetiology and Child-Pugh stage
entries.notes: 250 cirrhotic patients and 54 controls: common right/medial/anterior atrophy with lateral and caudate hypertrophy, modified by aetiology and stage.

entries.title: Cadaveric gallbladder fossa morphometry
entries.notes: Adult cadaveric gallbladder fossa volume 31.01 +/- 17.82 mL; use as a small open visceral indentation, not a large internal cavity.

entries.title: Adult cadaveric porta hepatis morphometry
entries.notes: Porta hepatis is a small posterior, slightly right-sided transverse oval; mean transverse/AP diameters 2.93/1.82 cm.

entries.title: User decision A: cirrhosis main and sensitivity values

entries.title: V2 tumor rasterization and feasibility contract
entries.notes: Actual-mask gates supersede metadata targets. Count within a reported stratum, conditional diameters, morphology mixing, subcapsular coverage and placement search are explicit engineering assumptions pending calibration against local lesion masks.

entries.title: V2 activity-field and necrosis engineering contract
entries.notes: Low-frequency fields, within-patient dependence and the size-to-necrosis function remain engineering assumptions; HCC lesion-level TNR and overall heterogeneity retain separate literature evidence.

entries.title: Broad-HCC sensitivity and coverage sampling design
entries.notes: Coverage weights are not prevalence.

entries.title: TARE-HCC stress challenge design
entries.notes: All stress cases have population_weight=0.

entries.title: SIMIND version 8 manual

entries.title: Local GE 870 CZT SIMIND SMC
entries.notes: Physical coordinate interpretation remains gated by Task 11.

entries.title: Local Tc-99m MAA acquisition protocol
entries.notes: 60 MBq, 28.4 s/view, 60 views, 30 cm orbit, 126-154 keV.

entries.title: V2 SIMIND runtime and alignment gates
entries.notes: Thresholds are frozen empirically after high-history asymmetric baselines.

entries.title: V2 patient joint-sampling model
entries.notes: The verified age median and male fraction remain literature_population; distribution shape and within-stratum correlations are explicit engineering priors.

entries.title: V2 population-anchored constructive liver geometry contract
entries.notes: The old V1 CSG is an engineering regression reference only, never anatomical truth. V2 uses literature-anchored target dimensions plus a continuous asymmetric shape family and never treats 14*weight+979 as a generative mean. Fullness calibration and all shape-quality thresholds are engineering QA contracts pending calibration against real liver masks, not literature-derived physiological cutoffs.
